input.title: Junior Front-End Developer
input.text:
We are looking for a Junior Front-end software developer who is eager to learn, thrives in a collaborative environment, and is motivated to grow and share knowledge.
What to expect:
• Join a team of smart engineers working on a project for an international client
• Work closely with an experienced software developer who’ll be guiding and mentoring you
• Contribute to the team goals and working on tasks covering the entire software development lifecycle (develop new and supporting existing features, troubleshoot issues, develop unit tests, prepare documentation, etc.)
• Actively communicate tasks, requirements, issues and open questions with your mentor, the team and the client
• Learn new technologies, attending technical and soft-skills trainings and taking professional certifications
The perfect candidate meets the following:
• Practical experience in general web development - HTML5, CSS3, React/Angular/Vue
• Solid understanding of JavaScript and particularly ES6(ES2015) features
• Knowledge of AJAX, Promises and async programming patterns
• Good understanding of web services
• Fluency in English
